"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Agendas in the organization should consistently include the issues of communities of color.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will consistently look for opportunities to work with activists in communities of color.",
